archetypes.name: dyn-step4-composite

archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed checks-commit-route Step 4 path. Focus on _run_step4_commit_leg, recovery recompute, pathspec freshness, and the 4.r relay. Verify failure outcomes emit the intended NEXT_ACTION or bail token without double-printing continue. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
